newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs called mostly steady -trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs called mostly steady -trade.

text.p: Midwest direct cash hog prices were called mostly steady Tuesday, with Illinois hogs called steady to weak then, livestock sources said.

Hog marketings should be light to moderate Tuesday, similar to Monday's, sources said. The slim marketings were predicted largely because, in recent weeks, hog prices have been at or near weekly highs on Friday. As a result, producers are in some cases, waiting to sell late in the week.
Iowa sources expect steady to firm prices Tuesday of $55.50 per cwt at plants and $54.00 to $54.50 in the country.
Iowa had a $56.00 top Monday but sources said that was for a small number of hogs and was not representative of the market.
Illinois sources expected steady to lower hog prices Tuesday on an apparent decline in demand. Poor operating margins had some packing plants reporting they were scaling back hog slaughter this week.
Freezing weather remained in Iowa Monday, but dealers from Illinois to Ohio reported mild weather.
